title: Pastéis de Nata
description: A traditional Portugal dish made with puff pastry, whole cow milk, lemon zest, egg yolk. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Roll the puff pastry tightly into a log, slice into rounds and press each into a small tart mold, pushing pastry thin up the sides. Chill the shells.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 6 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Beat the listed ingredients until pale and light; ensure butter and eggs are at room temperature when specified.
Fill the pastry cups three-quarters full and bake at 250–270°C until the pastry is crisp and the custard top shows dark caramelized spots; cool before unmolding.
